adjudication.reason: The promoted dependency-free DGO1 inverse is exact and materially faster in isolation, but the shipping v0.30 ML extraction remains 86.4% slower than accepted v0.29 in this focused fresh-process comparison. The focused extraction RSS samples tie exactly, so this measurement does not reproduce the earlier whole-suite RSS loss; it neither clears nor weakens the frozen full runtime/RSS gate.
adjudication.strongest_counterevidence: Transform-level speedup did not translate proportionally to complete-product extraction, so the remaining owner is outside, around, or redundantly repeating the DGO1 inverse. Another inverse-loop optimization is not justified until that boundary is measured.
adjudication.next_question: On the same shipping archive, what is the fresh-process end-to-end extraction delta when only the promoted inverse is toggled back to the preserved historical inverse? If the delta is small, localize manifest/policy verification/materialization; if large, determine why the observed v0.29 gap remains despite the recovered transform time.
